scope: Archived T estimates only; fixed original eligibility, predictions, and assignments; no D analysis.
interpretation: A category exclusion sensitivity analysis, not mathematical validation of retained labels.

contrast_definitions.residual_minus_router_logits: paired T(post_moe_residual) - paired T(router_logits), within each window
contrast_definitions.residual_minus_moe_output: paired T(post_moe_residual) - paired T(moe_output), within each window
contrast_definitions.position_gap: [T(residual)-T(all_router)] at divergence_k minus the same gap at suffix_k; all paired

bootstrap.estimator: ratio of resampled pair sums to pair counts; equal weight per pair
bootstrap.interval: marginal 95% percentile; linear quantiles; no multiplicity correction
bootstrap.shared_draws: identical eligible pair sets share draws; generator restarts per set
